# DeceptionDecoded

Image-caption news pairs with reference articles and simulated creator desires and editing plans. Intent-guided generation supplies misleadingness targets; these are constructed communicative intentions, not measurements of real journalists' motives.

## Example input and output

Author-published documentation example. It shows the data or task format, not a verified annotation row.

**Input:** Official dataset-card sample id 0: caption 'Authorities were unprepared for the large turnout at the Capitol Hill demonstration', paired with data/orig_images/0.jpg and reference article data/news_articles/0.txt.

**Output / label:** label: 0 (non-misleading); fine_grained_label: edit_t (non-misleading text edit). The sample's image is behind the dataset access gate and is not embedded here.

[Open the original example](https://huggingface.co/datasets/jiayingwu19/DeceptionDecoded)

**Location in source:** Dataset card, Data Format, sample instance id 0.

## Intention in this dataset

Image-caption news pairs with reference articles and simulated creator desires and editing plans. Intent-guided generation supplies misleadingness targets; these are constructed communicative intentions, not measurements of real journalists' motives.
